BiblicalUsage: Floats, or rafts, as the timber for Solomon's temple came down from Lebanon by sea on rafts, and Hiram promised to bring it to the place Solomon appointed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the temple's cedar travelled by raft, because God's house was built from the work of many hands and many miles.
